graph.title: TTX Intermodal Double-Stack Car
notes: The model is two identical flat-car halves (steps 1-15, built 2x, group 'car', each with its own end bogie/coupler), joined by a centre bogie whose two red pin axles go into the 2x4 Technic plates at the car ends.

Grey container is built once; its two end caps (1x4 base brick, 1x4 upper brick, grille brick, two handle bricks, tile) are a 2x repeat 'cap'. Blue, red and white containers are one 3x repeat 'box' (copy 1 blue with black grille/handle bricks, copy 2 red, copy 3 white); the grille and handle bricks take the box colour for red and white.
Piece counts reconcile with the 366-piece parts list: 2 cars x 90 + centre bogie 22 + grey container 58 + 3 boxes x 35 + 1 sticker sheet = 366.

The booklet pictures are small; exact stud-to-stud positions of many plates and panels were inferred. Most joins have null ports and are layer-to-layer stack joins; some multi-stud overlaps are recorded with only one or two representative edges.
Bogie sub-assembly pieces of the same type (2x4 dark-grey plate vs 2x6 plates, 1x2 door-rail plates) were assigned by matching the parts list counts.
The wheel holder, coupler and bogie plate catalogue entries have few/no stud ports, so their joins use null ports; the bogie plate pin goes into the middle pin-hole (3) of the end 2x6 Technic plate.
Containers resting on the cars and on each other are contact edges (rest) because they are not fastened.

Connectivity fix: the sticker sheet was the only isolated piece; it is now joined (stick, damaging to remove) to a side panel of car 1. The manual does not say which stickers go where (they go on both cars and the containers), so this single edge is a representative placement, not an exact one. The whole build is otherwise a single model.
